title: NekkFly
description: This is minecraft plugin for command /fly like "funtime", so fly only with elytra
body:
This plugin adds /fly as on the "FunTime" server, which was made by me, a beginner programmer, since /fly in "Essentials" is available even without elytra, but I need elytra to enable flight.

### Permissions:
  **nekkfly.fly** - _perm for main command_
  **nekkfly.admin** - _perm for reload command_
